description:
Per-locale event content in the catalog, localized storefront/back-office UI strings, localized emails and documents, locale-aware date/money formatting. Plumbing is born in US-002; this epic carries the breadth.

**Conditions of Success:**
- Full purchase path (browse → checkout → email → ticket) completable in FR and EN
- Event copy editable per locale in the back office; missing-translation fallback defined
- Adding a third locale requires no schema change

Lineage: docs/product/brief.md · docs/product/prd-v1.md (capability map). Origin: backlog grilling 2026-07-12.

comments.body: COS defined at epic level; decompose when prioritized (Gate 1). Owner: FR+EN from the start (French market later, international buyers now).
